    {
      "fromKey": "n-ax2alr",
      "toKey": "n-1ktiwpt",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The pressure drop (condition) occurred while the maintenance acceptance signature was pending. The lack of a signed release indicates an incomplete boundary preparation, which is consistent with the timing and context.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["n-ax2alr#1","eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the acceptance signature had been signed before 10:00 AM, would a pressure drop of this nature have occurred?",
      "competingExplanation": "The pressure drop could be unrelated to boundary status (e.g., upstream source failure), but the timing correlation with pending release is noted.",
      "evidenceGap": "No direct evidence links the specific pressure event to the unsigned signature; they are temporally coincident."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-ax2alr",
      "toKey": "n-srvaw4",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The blank temporary instruction field suggests no documented change control was attached to the work package at issue time. This condition existed when the pressure drop occurred.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["n-ax2alr#1","eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If a temporary instruction had been attached and reviewed, would the hazard scenario have been mitigated?",
      "competingExplanation": "The blank field may be administrative; it does not prove an unrecorded routing change occurred.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence confirms whether an actual service-routing change existed or if the pressure drop was due to a different cause."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-lzsmwx",
      "toKey": "n-1ktiwpt",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The area directory does not establish valve positions or pressure availability. This limitation means the crew could not verify boundary conditions via standard documentation, contributing to incomplete preparation.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["n-lzsmwx#1","b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the directory had shown valve states, would it have prevented or clarified the hazard?",
      "competingExplanation": "Even with a complete diagram, operational changes may not be reflected in static documents.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence of whether alternative verification methods (field checks) were used."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1q7qtf5",
      "toKey": "n-srvaw4",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The pending acceptance signature and blank temporary instruction field are linked as administrative gaps in the work package. Both reflect incomplete documentation at issue time.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the work package had been fully completed, would these gaps have existed?",
      "competingExplanation": "Administrative delays may not reflect physical hazards.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence of whether field conditions were verified despite documentation gaps."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1q7qtf5",
      "toKey": "n-lzsmwx",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The pending acceptance signature implies the boundary was not formally released. Combined with a directory that does not show valve states, this created conditions where verification relied on incomplete information.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1","b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the boundary had been formally released, would reliance on incomplete documentation have occurred?",
      "competingExplanation": "Formal release does not guarantee accurate field conditions.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence of whether alternative verification methods were used."
    }
  ],"decision":{"summary":"The focal event (instrument-air low-pressure indication) is supported by documented pressure drop and alarm activation.
